constrained_policy.behavior_logprob: Exact renormalized four-choice categorical at the unique divergent token.
constrained_policy.live_check: Before scientific arms, a one-step structural run must reproduce exact trace and packed-batch constrained logprobabilities within 0.02 nats.
constrained_policy.symmetry_rule: The identical constrained route policy is deployed in every rollout, replay branch, evaluator, exact scorer, broadcast arm, and sliced arm.
constrained_policy.target_policy: The target digit policy remains unconstrained.

arms.broadcast: Stock GRPO trajectory advantage assigned to root and target decisions.
arms.sliced: ReDCO trajectory LOO at the root and 11-branch LOO at the target with sliced replay.

design.excluded_arm: Full-suffix replay is not repeated because prior live sliced-vs-full learning-outcome equivalence passed; this gate isolates credit.

execution.artifacts: Recover every log, metric, trace, exact score payload, signed verifier output, merge manifest, final adapter, and decision. Compress final adapters independently and omit redundant intermediate broadcasts after hash recording.
execution.environment: Use persistent paths on the ephemeral pod for the uv environment and cache, and keep one pod alive through the authorized sequence.
execution.local_retention: Retain compact evidence and final arm adapters. Do not retain merged 4B models, optimizer state, CUDA caches, or remote uv caches.
pre_science_order: Verify every frozen source, adapter, rendered-config, and applied-patch hash.
Reconstruct the initialization and require byte identity to the Stage C5 reference.
Produce three byte-identical canonical score replicates and require unchanged factorization support.
Measure same-deployment vLLM exploration power without using it to decide factorization.
Run one structural live smoke and verify trace and packed-batch behavior logprobs.
Launch the eight frozen scientific arms in the preregistered alternation order.
execution.teardown: Always terminate compute after artifact recovery and confirm zero persistent disks.

causal_sanity.calls_to_threshold: First aligned policy-call point whose sampled evaluation target-success rate is at least 0.5.
causal_sanity.comparison: Calls-to-threshold is reported for both arms as a compute tradeoff; ReDCO is not required to beat broadcast because it receives fewer optimizer steps at matched calls.
causal_sanity.rule: On each causal probe, at least one arm must increase exact digit-5 mass by at least 0.05 from initialization.

frozen_metrics_and_decision.claim_limit: A pass supports reduced nuisance drift on this small mechanistic battery, not a broad population claim.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.fail: The gate is adequately exposed but one or more other mandatory checks fail.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.pass: Every support, primary, causal-sanity, completeness, and aligned-evaluation check in the frozen verifier passes.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.policy_distribution: For each recorded prefix, normalize exact vLLM temperature-2 probabilities over digit tokens 0-7 and compute Jensen-Shannon divergence from the shared warm start.

primary_irrelevant_target.directional_effect: Mean sliced JS divergence must be at most 75% of mean broadcast JS divergence.
primary_irrelevant_target.exposure_floor: Mean broadcast JS divergence across seeds must be at least 0.002; otherwise status is underpowered.
primary_irrelevant_target.pairwise_guard: For each seed, sliced JS may not exceed paired broadcast JS by more than 0.002.

frozen_metrics_and_decision.saturation_guard: If any exact final digit-5 mass is at least 0.98, endpoint margins are forbidden and only the frozen calls-to-threshold curve is used for sample-efficiency interpretation.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.underpowered: Either initialization support fails or the broadcast exposure floor is not met.

hardware.resource_pin_rule: Before provisioning, commit a hardware-only amendment naming the exact eligible resource ID, provider, location, and rate.
hardware.ssh_rule: Verify SSH noninteractively immediately after provisioning; terminate without scientific model calls if it fails.

byte_identity_gate.rule: The current and reference manifests must contain identical file sets, per-file SHA-256 values, and adapter SHA-256.

initialization.deployment: Merge the Stage C2 adapter into the named BF16 base, then merge the Stage C5 adapter into that result. Both arms start from the byte-identical final merged model.
initialization.deployment_reverification: Before any scientific arm, reconstruct the initialization, require every merged-model file hash to match the Stage C5 step-18 reference, then apply the split measurement protocol.

canonical_scorer.replicate_rule: All three signed action payloads and all three signed root payloads must be byte-identical.

factorization.failure_rule: Stop before scientific arms. Initialization engineering ends; do not alter the threshold or warm start.

runtime_power.purpose: Measure actual constrained-rollout exploration support and verify the structural smoke behavior logprob contract.

measurement_protocol.symmetry: The measurement split and constrained policy apply identically to broadcast and sliced arms.

rendered_configs.parse_validation: All nine TOML files parse through the pinned Prime-RL RLConfig before any v2 model call.

repair_and_redeploy_policy.after_first_scientific_arm_outcome: Never rerun an observed arm. Only exact continuation of previously unobserved frozen arms from retained byte-identical initialization is allowed.
repair_and_redeploy_policy.canonical_support_failure: Terminate v2 before scientific arms; do not change initialization, measurement, or thresholds.
eligible_failures: outcome-independent launcher, path, serialization, or orchestration defect
shared hardware failure unrelated to either algorithm
repair_and_redeploy_policy.if_exact_continuation_is_impossible: Terminate the campaign and report the partial result without replacement runs.
immutable_fields: tasks, arms, seeds, order, and matched call budgets
canonical scorer settings and replicate rule
repair_and_redeploy_policy.principle: Outcome-independent environment and deployment failures may be fixed transparently; measurements and scientific outcomes may not be retried or used to redesign the experiment.
repair_requirements: recover and commit all available evidence
make the minimal repair and add a regression test
commit and audit a repair amendment before redeployment
preserve existing canonical payloads and never rerun a completed replicate
record exact billing for every attempt

reporting.pareto_rule: Report both outcomes separately even if nuisance drift improves while calls-to-threshold worsens.
primary_outcomes: Known-noncausal target Jensen-Shannon drift from initialization.
Policy calls to the frozen causal target-success threshold.

scientific_question: On genuine two-decision workflows, does node-level all-branch LOO reduce policy drift at a known non-causal target compared with trajectory-broadcast GRPO, while preserving the ability to learn causal target actions?

score_stability_diagnosis.disposition: Do not relax a support threshold. Replace the unstable measurement with a deterministic canonical scorer.

stage_c6_v1_terminal.interpretation: V1 remains terminal. Its single-shot vLLM factorization result does not test either scientific arm.

tasks.common_random_numbers: For one ReDCO episode, root route and episode luck are sampled once and held fixed across all 11 target branches.
tasks.confusion_irrelevant: The root route changes reward; the targeted digit has no effect. This is the primary credit-confusion endpoint.
tasks.confusion_lucky: Target digit 5 and root route are causal while an episode-level +/-1 luck term is shared by every branch.
tasks.confusion_redundant: Reward succeeds when either root route delta or target digit 5 succeeds.
tasks.episode_diversity: Different episodes of the same task receive distinct deterministic root seeds via stable rollout addresses.
